focusedRegression.selection: tests whose names start with coach, habit, chat-view or ai-transport, excluding native postgres suites
focusedRegression.services: Synthetic Auth, quota, goals and Gemini; loopback HTTP only. No remote model evaluation.

limitations: The sandbox denied native PostgreSQL file operations and loopback connections.
The native PostgREST runtime required by the transactional HTTP suite was unavailable.
The initial attempt included a UI harness assertion corrected before the implementation commit; the final 24 UI tests passed.
The compiled HTTP test passed in the final focused regression after allowing local loopback.
globalSuite.scope: Closed persistence and security audits were not reopened or modified. The global attempt is not represented as a green gate.
